title: reportRecycling
description: The request body of EP-REPORT-RECYCLING (section 10.2 of the implementation specification).

passportIdentifier.description: The passport identifier of the recycled battery.

dataProviderBpnl.description: The Business Partner Number of the data provider of the passport.

nameplateManufacturerBpnl.description: The Business Partner Number of the manufacturer that the nameplate names.

recyclingDate.description: The date and time of the recycling.

receivedFromSuccessorBpnl.description: The Business Partner Number of the successor from whom the recycler received the battery.

materialRecyclingCertificateCatenaXId.description: The catenaXId of the material recycling certificate.

items.description: The Business Partner Number of the data provider of a predecessor passport.

predecessorDataProviderBpnls.description: The data providers of the predecessor passports that receive PassportEnded.
